desc:
Something huge is sleeping under the tavern. They call it Garganta, and you're going down its throat.

GARGANTA is a co-op roguelike shooter. Every floor is randomly built, every run is different, and when you die, you start over. Grab whatever items you find and stack them into weird, broken combos. Bombs, lasers, balls, blood... anything goes.

- Dive through cellars, fungus caves, flooded ruins and living flesh
- Hundreds of items, trinkets and secret synergies
- Unlock new classes, items and challenges every run
- Brutal bosses waiting at the bottom of each chapter
- Play solo or bring friends along
- Normal, Hard, and something worse

Between runs, hang out in the tavern, chat with the locals, buy cosmetics and figure out what the Replica company is really up to.

Inspired by The Binding of Isaac.
